버튼으로 릴레이를 켜서 5 V 램프(LED)를 스위칭하는 회로가 동작하지: A circuit that turns on a relay with a button to switch a 5 V lamp (LED) doesn't work. Fix the relay module's power and control wire.
릴레이가 코일(제어 쪽)과 접점(부하 쪽)이 전기적으로 분리된 스위치라는: Know that a relay is a switch whose coil (control side) and contacts (load side) are electrically isolated
COM, NO(평상시 열림), NC(평상시 닫힘)를 구분한다: Tell apart COM, NO (normally open) and NC (normally closed)
액티브 Low 입력 모듈을 다룬다: Handle a module with an active-Low input
**▶ 실행**하고 버튼을 눌러 보세요. 콘솔에는 `relay ON`이: Press **▶ Run** and press the button. The console shows `relay ON`, but the lamp doesn't light. Look at the checks below that show ❌.
**릴레이 모듈**: IN 신호가 트랜지스터를 켜서 코일에 전류가 흐르면: **Relay module**: the IN signal turns on a transistor, current flows through the coil, and the electromagnet pulls the contact over — **COM moves from NC to NO**.
부하(램프) 전류는 COM–NO 접점으로만 흐르고, MCU 핀은 모듈 입: The load (lamp) current flows only through the COM–NO contact; the MCU pin only drives the module's input. The coil needs **5 V**.
모듈 전원과 제어선 고치기: Fix the module's power and control wire
- 모듈 **VCC**를 3V3이 아니라 **5V**(위쪽 레일)에 연결: - Connect the module's **VCC** to **5V** (upper rail), not 3V3.
- **IN**은 펌웨어가 쓰는 **D7** (PA8)이어야 합니다. 지: - **IN** must be **D7** (PA8), the pin the firmware uses. Right now it is plugged into D8.
To delete a wire, click it and press the Delete key.
**▶ 실행**하고 버튼(D4)이나 B1을 누를 때마다 릴레이가 딸깍 켜: Press **▶ Run**; every press of the button (D4) or B1 clicks the relay on or off, and the lamp follows. LD2 also shows the relay's state.
이 모듈은 **액티브 Low**: IN = 0이면 코일이 켜집니다. 그래: This module is **active Low**: IN = 0 turns the coil on. So at startup the firmware first writes the pin High and only then makes it an output
(안 그러면 리셋 직후 잠깐 릴레이가 켜짐). 버튼은 200 ms 디바운: (otherwise the relay would switch on briefly right after reset). The button uses a 200 ms debounce so that one press counts once.
램프를 NC에 연결 — 릴레이가 꺼져 있을 때 켜지는 반대 동작이 됩니다: Connecting the lamp to NC — it does the opposite, lighting while the relay is off.
Driving the relay module from 3V3 — the coil doesn't pull in, or is unreliable.
실제 220 V를 브레드보드로 — 절대 금지. 수업에서는 저전압 부하만: Real 220 V on a breadboard — absolutely never. In class we only handle low-voltage loads.
버튼을 2초 이상 누르면 릴레이가 10초 동안만 켜지는 타이머 기능을 추: Add a timer feature: holding the button for 2 seconds or more turns the relay on for just 10 seconds.
